name: review-animations
description: Review animation and motion code against a high craft bar — a motion-design reviewer that flags sluggish easing, wrong origins, non-GPU properties, missing reduced-motion, and "it looks cool" animations on high-frequency actions, then returns a findings table and a Block/Approve verdict. Use when reviewing a diff that touches transitions, keyframes, springs, or gesture code, or when asked to review whether an animation feels right.
